title: Behavior Go Home
description: Allows the mob to move back to the position they were spawned.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

goal_radius.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity is considered to have reached home.

interval.description: Time in ticks between home checks.

on_failed.description: Event(s) to run when this goal fails.

on_home.description: Event(s) to run when this mob gets home.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier while going home.
